summary: Opportunistic actors are exploiting PAN-OS vulnerabilities CVE-2024-0012 and CVE-2024-9474 for unauthenticated remote code execution. Post-exploitation activity includes deploying simple PHP web shells, Sliver implants, and crypto miners. A specific Sliver implant has been observed communicating with a C2 at 77.221.158.154.
